name: resource-list-01
title: Resource List 01 - A Document And Download Index In A Real Table
description: A document and download index drawn as a real table with column headers and a row header per document: a name, a kind, a reading for a size, a format or a last-changed moment, and a link. The column names are the caller's, the cells are the Block's, and groupBy renders a body per kind rather than a merged cell. Every string, and the whole set, is passed in as a prop.
